description: Storing data with key-value pairs using objects.

lessons.title: What is a Function?
lessons.content: Functions are reusable blocks of code designed to perform a specific task. They help keep your code organized and allow you to avoid repetition.

lessons.title: Function Declaration
Function Parameters and Arguments
lessons.content: Parameters are placeholders for values that you pass to a function. When calling the function, the actual values passed are called arguments.

lessons.title: Return Statement
lessons.content: The `return` statement specifies the value a function should output after execution. Without a return statement, a function returns `undefined` by default.

lessons.title: Function Expression
Arrow Functions
Function Scope
lessons.content: Variables declared inside a function are local to that function and cannot be accessed outside it. This encapsulation helps avoid naming conflicts.

lessons.title: Default Parameters
Functions Calling Other Functions
Understanding Callback Functions
lessons.content: A callback function is a function passed as an argument to another function, which is then executed inside the outer function. This is useful for asynchronous operations.
